core_obligations: Reduce the equivalence to the two adjunction maps being isomorphisms for every pair of corresponding objects (proof lines 1728-1734).
Introduce the hypothesis that both objects are supported on a closed subset contained in a union of n affine opens, and set up the induction on n (proof lines 1735-1748).

Base case: with no affine opens the objects vanish, and because the inclusion of quasi-coherent modules is fully faithful and exact the other object vanishes as well, so both adjunction maps are isomorphisms (proof lines 1749-1758).

Induction step: write the support as contained in n affine opens, take the last one, and use the distinguished triangle cutting the objects along that open and its complement to reduce the statement for n to the statements for n minus one and for the affine open (proof lines 1759-1785).
Conclude with the two coherator statements that settle the affine open case, which finishes the induction and hence the proof (proof lines 1786-1798).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to the two adjunction isomorphisms and set up the induction on the number of affine opens (proof lines 1728-1748).
Base case with no affine opens (proof lines 1749-1758).
Induction step by cutting along an affine open, using the coherator statements (proof lines 1759-1798).
difficulty_reason: 71 行、归纳论证：先把「两个函子互逆」化为单位与余单位两个伴随映射是同构；再引人「对象支撑在至多 n 个仿射开集之并的闭子集上」这一假设并对 n 归纳——n=0 时对象为零、由拟凝聚模到模的包含函子全忠实且正合推出另一个也为零；归纳步用「沿一个仿射开集与其补作 distinguished triangle」把 n 化为 n-1 与单个仿射情形，后者由两条 coherator 引理解决。承重步骤（约化到伴随映射、归纳切分、基例）都在 span 内；5 处引用（3 同章、2 跨章）作导航桩。
